attributes.action: Reintroduce the death penalty for Rape, pedophilia, Murder, Treason, terrorism
attributes.additional_details:
Prisons would gain the much needed space if this was applied. Any serious convict would be eradicated from life without any future danger to prison staff and civilians. 

I think this should be adopted  with immediate effect.
attributes.background:
Any one convicted 100% of rape, pedophilia, terrorism, espionage, treason. Should be evaluated and to be tried  For the death penalty. 

The uk should adopt  our old values with new rulings on this for the above crimes. 

The death sentence would be a deterrent and life should be life in the uk.

rejection.details: You may wish to sign this petition which calls for a similar action: Reintroduce the death penalty for Treason, Rape, Murder, Terrorism & Espionage https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/760749
